name: Niergus
backstory: Child of Magus and Nierius; raised in Salthos Cruzados on walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., and carries some knowledge of Salthos Cruzados.

experience: Learned that Prince Doran has died.

experience.text: Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darnarika.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Crossing Toll Dispute

criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
